svg.title: Validation: pass rates per study and arm
svg.desc: Validation: 474 of 484 recorded attempts passed across 42 study and arm rows. Task sets differ between studies.
svg.text: Pass rate per study and arm. Bars share a 0 to 100% scale. Labels give passed attempts / all attempts.
Task sets differ between studies. See the tables for timing, models, engine versions and failed runs.
